hero.title: Become a Leader. Shape the Future of Germany's Economy.
hero.subtitle: Join a community of up to 50 high-achieving students preparing for leadership roles through real responsibility, practical experience, and mentoring. 39 years of alumni success prove what you can achieve.

intro.title: TEG is not for everyone. 10+ hours of work per week. Real respon­sibility. Relia­bility of a leader.
intro.line1: If you invest this time, it will change your life.
intro.line2: 300+ alumni, including 41 corporate executives, 40 SME executives, and 15 founders of successful companies.
intro.line3: Founded in 1986 by BMW, Roland Berger, BCG, KPMG, Siemens, and more, TEG is now one of the most renowned talent incubators in the German-speaking world.

howItWorks.mainTitle: How we make you into such a person

step1.title: You become part of TEG
step1.desc1: At the TEG office, you meet like-minded individuals who want more and are ready to deliver.
step1.desc2: In an exclusive community of up to 50 members, we support each other with skills, responsibility, and real camaraderie.

step2.title: Your value as a member
step2.desc1: All programs at TEG are designed to accelerate your career, whether you want to become a founder, executive, or corporate successor.
step2.box1: Learn firsthand how to run a company
step2.box2: Position yourself strategically and accelerate your career path
step2.box3: Grow through a strong community and its connections
step2.desc2: Our members take on entrepreneurial responsibility in real projects, not someday, but now.

step3.title: How exactly does TEG create this value?
step3.desc1: TEG is the only student-run organization in Munich with its own office at the English Garden, including fixed costs, budget responsibility, and real ownership.
step3.desc2: Our members run TEG like a company and learn how to lead one.
step3.desc3: Additionally, there are exclusive programs and formats:

sub1.title: Learn how companies work and gain insights others take years to acquire.

box1.title: Task Forces
box1.desc: Lead a project within TEG and develop essential leadership skills. You'll learn how to manage teams, allocate resources, and make decisions.

box2.title: Founders-Associate Programs
box2.desc: Work alongside one of our founders and gain exclusive insights into strategy, growth, and leadership firsthand. You're not a spectator; you're part of the execution.

box3.title: Executive-Associate Programs
box3.desc: Complete an internship at the C-level with one of our partner companies, directly under the management, department head, or board. You'll be challenged, supported, and taken seriously.

sub2.title: Accelerate your career through strategic positioning

box1.title: Panel Talks
box1.desc: You're invited as an expert to speak at public events on panels, stages, and workshops. This not only develops your presence but also positions you publicly as a thought leader.

box2.title: Talent Development
box2.desc: With targeted support, we help you develop your personal brand. This includes LinkedIn visibility, storytelling, speaker coaching, and individual positioning strategies.

sub3.title: Benefit from a strong community and its connections

box1.title: Mentoring
box1.desc: You get a personal mentor from the TEG network – someone who is already where you want to be. You'll receive support with your challenges, decisions, and growth goals.

box2.title: Company Visits
box2.desc: We organize regular visits to companies we collaborate with. These connections not only help you understand the corporate world but also open doors for career entry, projects, and management positions.

step4.title: What exactly do you do in the organization?
step4.desc1: Because we run TEG like a real company, you don't just 'work in the organization' – you take on responsibility in an entrepreneurial setting.
step4.desc2: TEG is structured like a company: with clear departments, real roles, and operational execution. Whether you're in marketing, strategy, or the events team, you think entrepreneurially and act with impact.
step4.desc3: Leverage your strengths, lead a task force, actively participate in our programs. You don't just contribute; you take responsibility, shape, and lead.

howItWorks.lastline: After one semester, you'll have more entrepreneurial knowledge than 99% of people.

benefits.title: What you can expect at TEG
list: Access to your own office & infrastructure
Responsibility from day one: projects, budgets, team leadership

requirements.title: What you should bring
list: Desire to learn and perform under the guidance of a CEO or director
Motivation to think and act at an executive level
A doer mindset – no waiting, just executing
requirements.extraLine: Shape the economy. Shape your future. Shape your mind.

callToAction1.title: Are you ready to start your leadership career?
callToAction1.description: Take responsibility. Become a member of TEG and gain the skills, community, and experience you need to become tomorrow's corporate leader.
